# netbox_virtual_circuit_terminations (Data Source)

Retrieves all virtual circuit terminations from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_virtual_circuit_terminations" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "created"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "virtual_circuit_terminations_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_virtual_circuit_terminations.example.virtual_circuit_terminations[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `virtual_circuit_terminations` (Attributes List) The virtual circuit terminations found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_circuit_terminations))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--virtual_circuit_terminations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtual_circuit_terminations`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String) When the virtual circuit terminations was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the virtual circuit terminations, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the virtual circuit terminations.
- `id` (Number) The id of the virtual circuit terminations.
- `interface_id` (Number) The ID of the interface associated with the virtual circuit terminations.
- `last_updated` (String) When the virtual circuit terminations was last changed.
- `role` (String) The role of the virtual circuit terminations.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `virtual_circuit_id` (Number) The ID of the virtual circuit associated with the virtual circuit terminations.
